saw_lines: Couture buyers don’t commit to a label from a text ad. They commit to a look they can picture on themselves.
So the sale is won in the first second of a video or the first line of a text ad.
Your 127 Google creatives include 35 text, 4 image and only 1 video, so the look never moves. Shoot three short films on the body and cut them for YouTube and Google.
ads_1: Short couture films on the body, cut for Google video and YouTube
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and Youtube, the two linked channels
